summary.en: A sci-fi anti-gravity racer that set the standard for what WebGL could do in its day.
summary.zh: 科幻风反重力竞速，早年 WebGL 性能的标杆之作。

description.en: Pilot a hover craft down a glowing hexagonal track at ridiculous speed — steer with the arrows, boost with space. Scraping the walls costs momentum, and it's three timed laps to prove yourself.
description.zh: 在六边形赛道上高速竞速，方向键转向、空格加速，撞到边界会减速，三圈计时排名。

howto.en: Arrow keys to steer, space to boost.

tip.en: The most visually striking entry in the collection — ideal front-page material: big hero image plus a play-now button. Assets are large (HD textures), so lazy-load them behind a progress bar.
tip.zh: 视觉冲击最强的收录项，适合当站点门面（首屏大图 + 立即试玩）。资源较大（高清贴图），建议懒加载 + 预加载进度条。
